Knowledge recorded by Shinnecock elders in 2014

Sassafras

The catalogue describes sassafras as a culturally important tree used for flavoring, aromatic products, and historical remedies. Elders remembered sharing sassafras tea with newcomers during sickness.1

Places named in the catalogue

Shinnecock residential territories; New York State.1

Page references

The Shinnecock Environmental Department compiled this catalogue from elders’ memories and community resource knowledge in 2014. Food and medicine appear here as historical knowledge; safe identification and treatment require current guidance.

Shinnecock Environmental Department, Natural Resources Identified by Shinnecock Elders, April 4, 2014, PDF p. 21. Page numbers count the cover as PDF page 1.
